# mdesume

> A free, open-source, local-first Markdown resume builder. Generates clean, ATS-friendly, single-page and paginated PDFs directly in the browser.

mdesume transforms standard GitHub Flavored Markdown and intuitive layout symbols (columns, date rows, badges, icons, ratings) into professional resumes with eighteen tested themes. No account, no backend, no tracking — your data stays in your browser.

## Core Documentation

- [Markdown Format & AI Guide](https://mdesume.rohitchouhan.com/guide.md): Complete schema, symbols, syntax, and AI instructions for generating mdesume resumes.
- [Interactive Guide](https://mdesume.rohitchouhan.com/guide): Interactive documentation with live rendered examples of every layout symbol.
- [Resume Format Reference](https://github.com/rohit-chouhan/mdesume/blob/main/resume-format.md): Canonical repository reference for the resume format.

## Key Features & Schema

- **ATS-Friendly**: Pure semantic text and standard fonts without canvas or rasterized text.
- **Eighteen Themes**: Classic, Modern, Minimalist, Elegant, Creative, Neo-Brutal, Aesthetic, Professional, Bold Impact, Academic, Executive, Tech, Aurora, Nordic, Emerald, Compact ATS, Monochrome, Terminal.
- **Layout Symbols**:
  - `::row:: ... ::end-row::`: Title and date split row
  - `::col-2::`, `::col-3::`, `::col-4::`: Multi-column blocks
  - `::align-center::`, `::align-left::`, `::align-right::`, `::align-justify::`: Text alignment
  - `::badges:: ... ::end-badges::`: Pill badges for skills and tags
  - `::badge[Text]::`: Single inline pill badge
  - `::rating-4::`: 5-bar proficiency indicators (0 to 5)
  - `::page-break::`: Multi-page print break
  - `::icon[name]::`: Inline glyphs (mail, phone, globe, github, linkedin, etc.)
  - `::avatar[url]::`: Floated circular profile picture
  - `::qr[url]::`: Embedded local vector QR code
- **Defaults**: H1 18pt, H2 12pt, H3 11pt, Body text 10pt, Line height 1.2, Default Theme Classic.
- **Local-first**: Stored in browser IndexedDB. Real vector PDF export via native browser print.
